integrity: The exact two-mode scalar profile also arises on a different sparse double-star graph, so it is not claimed to be new alone. The contribution is the all-internal-conductance invariance for dense graph barbells, the global strict edge comparisons, extremizer rigidity and peak limit. Published broader equivalences are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Unnormalized weighted combinatorial Laplacian; two equal cliques of order m≥2; hub-spoke and bridge conductance 1; arbitrary symmetric internal peripheral conductances c_ij≥1; unweighted unit-edge graph metric; real Lipschitz functions. Other graphs, weights and metrics not covered; independent validation not performed.
title: Conductance-independent sharp heat-Lipschitz norms on clique barbells
